name: Mary J. Kiefer
bio: Mrs. John Kiefer was in Minnesota in poor health late in 1884 and returned to Medora in May 1885 from her long visit east, her health almost entirely restored. In 1886 the paper printed a sheriff's sale notice in a foreclosure suit by the Northern Pacific Refrigerator Car Company against her and her husband for $1,327.53 on a mortgage.

moments.label: Returned to Medora with health restored
Named in a foreclosure sale notice

mentions: Mrs. John Kiefer is still in Minnesota and not much improved in health. It is to be hoped that she will soon recover and return to Medora.
Mrs. John Kiefer returned last night from her long visit east. Her health is almost entirely restored.
